resources.string: Session transport: WSS %1$d · TCP %2$d · relay %3$d · CF %4$d · H2 %5$d
Last event from an individual session: %1$s
Remote transport is established. Session counts do not confirm Telegram message delivery.
Connectivity to remote servers has not been confirmed.
32 HEX characters. Pasted dd/ee secrets are decoded with their prefix and domain.
APK updates preserve the secret. Generate a new one only to replace it, then update the proxy entry in Telegram.
Settings are saved before sharing the link. If the secret, port or Fake TLS changed, disable the old proxy entry in Telegram and add the current link.
Rejected client headers during the last run: %1$d. The proxy is now stopped.
Create a secret and replace the unavailable one
Encrypted settings could not be read and were preserved. Re-enter your relay URL when recovering if you used one. Creating a new secret replaces the old one; update the Telegram proxy link.
New secret saved. Update the proxy link in Telegram.
The proxy is available on this device only, via 127.0.0.1. This is not a VPN. Opening the port does not confirm Telegram connectivity.
Enter a port from 1 to 65535, a 32-character HEX secret and a valid WSS relay URL, or leave the URL empty.
Could not open the local port. It may be in use. Choose another port.
Could not decrypt the stored secret. Explicitly create a new secret.
Could not save protected settings. The service was not started.
An invalid MTProto connection was rejected.
A WSS handshake attempt failed. The server uses available fallback routes.
TLS verification failed for one attempt. Certificate verification remains mandatory.
Could not establish a remote TCP connection.
A client session ended after a network or protocol error.
The limit of concurrent clients has been reached.
A connection was closed after a timeout.
The network changed. Current sessions were closed; Telegram can reconnect.
Android did not allow the service to start. Return to the app and try again.
No application was found to open the Telegram link.
Rejected client headers: %1$d. This is not a local server failure.
A client is establishing a remote transport. No sessions are active yet.
Last rejection: the header does not match supported Obfuscated2.
Last rejection: secret or MTProto format validation failed. Check the secret and proxy link in Telegram.
Last rejection: unsupported DC. Main DCs 1–5 are supported; test DCs are not enabled.
Last rejection: Fake TLS verification failed. Check the mode and Telegram link, secret and device time.
Empty: direct Telegram WSS/TCP routes. If your carrier blocks their IPs, a reachable relay that you control is required.
Relay only: wss://domain/path, port 443. A compatible Worker must support dst/dc. No direct fallback. The address is hidden and encrypted; use Show above to reveal it. Avoid untrusted relays.
Could not connect to the WSS relay. Check its address, path key and reachability on this network. Direct routes are disabled in relay mode.
Routes are cooling down after failures. Telegram can retry; the delay is capped at 30 seconds.
HTTP/2 route unavailable. Trying permitted fallback routes.
Name resolution failed on the current network.
No validated internet access. The local listener remains running.
Order: Workers → Cloudflare Proxy → TCP. Endpoint priority follows line order. Only your configured endpoints.
CF proxy base domains, one per line
Worker WSS URLs, one per line
Requires a compatible /api server. ALPN h2 is checked before user data. Reachability depends on the external endpoint.
Check lists: up to 8 domains and 8 WSS URLs. Automatic mode requires at least one endpoint.
Fake TLS camouflages the local Telegram → TGWS connection. It does not replace external WSS certificate checks or guarantee reachability. Update the Telegram link after enabling.
dd/ee secret or local Telegram link
Local configuration imported. Review settings and start the proxy.
Invalid secret or local Telegram link. External listener addresses are unsupported.
MTProto bytes: from Telegram %1$d · delivered to Telegram %2$d

Results describe the last check/session. Handshake and setup time are not Telegram E2E or Telegram ping. IPv6 presence does not prove reachability. Filtering cause remains undetermined without verification.
Manual check: at most once per 30s, up to 3 endpoints. No Telegram messages are sent.
Route traffic (cumulative): sent %1$d B · received %2$d B

Route #%1$d · DC %2$d · %3$s
%4$s · stage: %5$s
Checked: %6$s · setup: %7$s ms
Last failure: %8$s · route attempts: %9$d
PLMN/APN are references, not bypass profiles. TGWS does not change APN, DNS or SIM. Android observations take priority for MNP, MVNO and roaming.
Check requested; the 30s limit applies. Actual results appear in diagnostics.
Measured phases, ms: DNS %1$s · TCP %2$s · TLS %3$s · HTTP %4$s. Reused phases are not measured again.

The app uses DNS from the active Android network, including system Private DNS and carrier DNS64. Built-in Cloudflare DNS has been removed; Android settings stay unchanged. A blocked IP or domain requires a reachable relay.
Stop the proxy to change connection settings.
Internet access is not yet validated by Android
Address families come from the active Android interface. Remote-server reachability is checked separately.
Glass panels with a soft backdrop and highlights. Experimental appearance; off by default.
Beta: see the app backdrop through cards and panels. Works independently or with Liquid Glass; off by default.
Event recording is disabled in settings.
Clear events and chart from memory? Proxy, settings and traffic counters will continue unchanged.

The report includes app and WebView versions, event categories, connection stages and counters. Secrets, IP addresses, relay addresses, carrier and message contents are excluded. Review the file before sharing.
One TCP connection to the selected port on 127.0.0.1, without sending a secret. This checks the listener, not MTProto authentication or Telegram availability.
The port accepted a TCP connection during the last check.
The last connection was refused: check that the proxy is running on the selected port.
Local check encountered an I/O error.

Records availability, version and changes of the selected WebView provider. No browser engine is started: TGWS UI and proxy are native. Page logs and other apps’ logs are unavailable. Latest Stable/Beta status requires a separate check.
No available provider found. The native proxy does not depend on WebView.
Android did not provide provider information.
Complete the Android Wi-Fi sign-in, then run the route check again.
No active Android network. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data; the service keeps the local listener available.
Check that Telegram uses the port and secret saved in TGWS. Reopen the link from the app; do not generate a new secret to fix a network error.
The client closed before a complete MTProto header arrived. The secret was not checked; this does not prove a wrong key. Check reconnection and the session end reason in the journal.
The MTProto header format or DC is unsupported. Check the rejection category in the journal; it does not automatically imply a wrong secret.
Choose another free local port and reopen the Telegram proxy link.
The system network could not resolve the route hostname. Check Android Private DNS, Wi-Fi sign-in and the configured endpoint.
Check the device date, server hostname and certificate. TLS validation remains required.
Run the route check. If direct addresses are unreachable, use a configured, reachable WSS relay. A timeout alone cannot identify a blocking mechanism.
The endpoint ended the transfer at its byte limit. The experimental Worker allows 16 MiB per session; large media needs a compatible endpoint with suitable limits.
After network recovery Telegram creates new sessions. Allow the bounded backoff to finish and retry the check without changing the secret.
The secret has not been replaced. If the Keystore key was lost, explicitly recover the configuration in connection settings.
Duration %1$d ms · sent %2$d B · received %3$d B
Selection uses only configured, permitted transports in the current connection mode. Active sessions are never migrated. Stop the proxy to edit settings.
This profile has no permitted configured routes. Change its primary transport, permissions or connection mode.
Disabling this keeps a minimum delay after failure. Overload protection and Retry-After always apply.
No WSS warmup. A previously failed route is probed at most every 5 minutes, only when a new session needs a route; balanced mode uses one minute.
Off; existing route order is preserved
Attempts: %1$d · Established: %2$d · With inbound data: %3$d · Failures: %4$d
Up to 128 observations over 10 minutes. Quality needs at least 5 conclusive outcomes. An open socket does not confirm Telegram traffic; setup time is not Telegram ping.
Measured incoming and outgoing traffic chart, with closure and network-change markers
Blue: outgoing, green: incoming, red: recovery. Up to 60 samples, at most once per second. Rates use local transport counters, with no background network requests for the chart.
Off by default. Outages longer than 30 seconds, recovery, fallback and critical configuration; at most once per category every 5 minutes. Android notification permission is required.
The external connection has not recovered for over 30 seconds. Open diagnostics.
Inbound data has resumed after the outage.
A permitted backup transport was selected. See diagnostics for details.
Proxy configuration error. Check the settings in the app.
The active Smart profile orders permitted routes. Switching applies only to new sessions.
Primary and backup WSS nodes, checks and media routes
Up to 8 origin nodes. Enabling and saving replaces the single relay selection without changing existing secrets or URLs. Active streams never migrate.
Direct mode does not use relays. Choose relay-only or automatic mode in Transport settings.
Prefer origin relays for media DCs
New media sessions and permitted transports only. Smart manual/failover priorities remain enforced. File size is unknown in advance; MTProto bytes stay unchanged.
Allow media DCs on this node
After editing the list, save settings using the top card. URLs are encrypted and hidden by default.
Remove this node? MTProto secret and other settings are retained. Save to persist the change.
Wait 30 seconds before checking this node again.
Checks run only on demand without MTProto packets. Successful Upgrade does not prove Telegram availability. Checks cancel on network changes, leaving this page or stopping the Activity.
VPS Relay Manager is enabled. The single URL is retained for compatibility; the manager selects current nodes.
Enter a name and unique WSS address. Maximum eight nodes.
